name: Ca chuoi nuong
summary: Cá chuối nướng is grilled fish the 15 February 2023 culture page ties to đầm Vân Long. It says the flesh is white, with peanuts and herbs, dipped in nước mắm.
origin: Vân Long, Ninh Bình. Cá trê nướng is a different fish on the conservation page.
howToEat: Eat it with peanuts, herbs, and fish sauce, as Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao says.
where: With the Vân Long boat. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca chuoi nuong — grilled fish at Van Long
seoDescription: Grilled snakehead at Vân Long, with peanuts, herbs, and fish sauce, from the 15 February 2023 page.
